proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.unlimited
proposed_widenings.justification: The three command words have no stated usage limit or cooldown. ActivatedAbilityMechanics requires a resource: ActivationResource, and UseCountCap has no 'unlimited' variant. Inventing a large fixed number or a 'never' cadence would be dishonest about what the SRD says.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.no_occupants (or ActivationPredicate.no_occupants)
proposed_widenings.justification: The third command word can only be invoked 'if no creatures are aboard.' EquipmentPredicate covers only equipment wearing/wielding/holding gates; there is no variant for item-occupancy state. This requires either a new EquipmentPredicate variant or a broader ActivationPredicate union that includes item-state conditions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard.

notes: The alter_item_kind atom was added precisely for Folding Boat-style form-transformation items and is sufficient. The activation family and composite mechanics shape both exist. Encoding is blocked by two UseCountCap/EquipmentPredicate surface gaps only. The box's passive storage capability (container_storage atom) would also apply to the default box form but is secondary to the transformation mechanics.
